bindings.unresolved_scope_note: The problem facts do not state the procurement-launch date. The final answer must apply the Procurement Act 2023 only after determining that no saved pre-24-February-2025 procurement procedure governs.

material_claims.proposition: The Public Contracts Regulations 2015 continue to apply to procurement procedures and contracts within the specified transitional circumstances.
material_claims.exact_normalized_span_text: despite the revocation of the 2015 regulations by section 119(1) of, and paragraph 5 of schedule 11 to, the act, those regulations continue to apply, as modified by paragraph (4) b, c, d and e, in respect of procurement procedures, contracts, framework agreements and dynamic purchasing systems in any of the circumstances described in paragraphs (2) and (3).

material_claims.proposition: The transitional circumstances include specified awards, negotiations, notices and opportunity publications occurring before 24 February 2025.
material_claims.exact_normalized_span_text: the circumstances in this paragraph are that, with reference to the 2015 regulations, before 24th february 2025 - a a contracting authority has awarded the contract, concluded the framework agreement or established the dynamic purchasing system; b a contracting authority has contacted an economic operator in order to commence the negotiated procedure without prior publication in any of the specific cases and circumstances set out in regulation 32; c either- i a contract notice required by regulation 26(8) or 75(1) a (publication of notices: public contracts for social and other specific services), or ii a contest notice required by regulation 79 (notices) has been submitted for publication in accordance with regulation 51; d a contracting authority has had published on the uk e-notification service a voluntary transparency notice expressing its intention to enter into a contract in accordance with regulation 99(3) b (grounds for ineffectiveness: one of the conditions for the non-application of the first ground); e a contracting authority has published information about a contract award opportunity on contracts finder in accordance with regulation 110(2) (publication of contract award opportunities on contracts finder).

material_claims.proposition: Where the saved 2015 regime continues, the Procurement Act 2023 does not apply.

currentness_claims.proposition: The provisions listed in the Schedule came into force on 24 February 2025.
currentness_claims.exact_normalized_span_text: the provisions of the act set out in the schedule come into force on 24th february 2025.

currentness_claims.proposition: The commencement and transition instrument extends to England and Wales.
currentness_claims.exact_normalized_span_text: these regulations extend to england and wales, scotland and northern ireland.

bindings.proposed_action: Approve this official instrument as currentness and transition evidence. Do not automatically assume the 2023 Act applies without a procurement-start-date finding.
